I have informed Mr. Haseeb to proceed with the pool cleaning at 5:00 PM.

Regarding the yearly contract, as discussed with Lamya, we kindly request you to contact our Property Management team at pm@famliving.com, as they will be able to assist you further.

Since we are the Reservations team, we do not have the required information regarding yearly contracts. We can only assist with guest-related requests, such as coordinating with the guest for the pool cleaning or any other stay-related matters.

Thank you for your understanding.
